provenance.method: Eight purposively selected unused PRs were labelled from local merged diffs and canonical trigger contracts before either prediction. The same worker labelled and implemented; labels were visible during revision. This is not an independent blind review, a random sample or a population accuracy estimate. Route changes were planned from heldout3 and tested with synthetic fixtures; heldout4 was not used for tuning.
